title: ABIZ Business Record (protocol family abiz1)
description: Normative structural schema for the published ABIZ 1.0 specification, with the ABIZ 1.1 (proposed) business_key, registration_number and case-insensitive country rules, snake_case member names, and the REQUIRED public_key and signature members (SPEC section 4.6). $defs/retired_key reserves a nested retired-key shape; it is not a record property. The schema checks only the form of public_key and signature: a consumer MUST also verify the signature over the RFC 8785 canonical record and compare public_key with the DNS or well-known p. Independent DNS and registry checks are required for full conformance.

record_version.description: Wire protocol family abiz1. Document revisions, including a proposed 1.1, may advance without changing this value.

country.description: Assigned ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Case-insensitive; canonical form is lowercase. The validator checks it against data/iso3166.json.

identity_host.description: DNS h value: lowercase DNS hostname with optional path; never includes https://

domains.description: Business-controlled domain names this record claims. DNS cross-check must confirm control.

public_key.description: REQUIRED (ABIZ 1.1, SPEC section 4.6.1). The business's Ed25519 public key: standard base64 of 32 bytes, 44 characters, one trailing '='. MUST equal the p value of the DNS assertion or well-known file that points to this record.

business_key.description: country[-subdivision]-registration-number (SPEC section 4.2.1). Case-insensitive; canonical form has lowercase country and subdivision and an uppercase number. Assigned codes and the subdivision rule (section 4.2.2) are checked by the validator.

registration_number.description: Normalised registration number: ASCII letters and digits only (SPEC section 4.2.3). Case-insensitive; canonical form is uppercase.

mcp_server_url.description: Optional. No conformance requirement to operate an MCP server.

last_updated.description: UTC date and time of the last change to the record. Covered by the signature; producers SHOULD include it and update it on every re-signing (SPEC section 4.6.6).

country.description: Assigned ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, case-insensitive.

extensions.description: Vendor-namespaced extensions (reverse-domain keys); consumers may ignore unfamiliar extensions. Member names inside an extension are vendor-defined; snake_case is RECOMMENDED. Extensions are covered by the signature.

signature.description: REQUIRED (ABIZ 1.1, SPEC section 4.6). PureEd25519 signature, standard base64 of 64 bytes (88 characters), over the UTF-8 octets of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical serialisation of this record with the signature member removed. Verified with public_key.

retired_key.description: ABIZ 1.1 (proposed). Reserved shape of one retired Ed25519 public key. Not a business-record property: no record property refers to this definition, and unknown top-level properties such as retired_keys are rejected. DNS must not carry retired keys.

public_key.description: Retired Ed25519 public key: 32 bytes, standard base64, one trailing '='.

valid_from.description: Optional UTC instant when this key became current.

retired_at.description: UTC instant when this key stopped being current. For reason compromised, the asserted compromise time.

binding_signature.description: PureEd25519 signature by the current key, standard base64 of 64 bytes. ABIZ 1.1 does not define the signed message.
